description: Source code for QBreakpadHandler class, managing crash dump handling and uploading using Google Breakpad in a Qt application.

classes.name: QBreakpadHandlerPrivate
classes.description: Private data class holding exception handler pointer, dump path, and upload URL.

classes.name: QBreakpadHandler
classes.description: Main class managing crash dump handling, including setting dump path, uploading, and dump file management.

methods.description: Returns the version string of the QBreakpadHandler.

methods.description: Sets the directory for dump files and initializes the exception handler.

methods.description: Returns a list of dump files in the dump directory.
